# The hub (level95)

The Warriors' clubhouse and the streets of Coney around it, where the story returns between missions. Its checkpoint
picks the chapter and which mission the clubhouse offers next; it also starts the flashbacks and the bonus game.

## What it needs {#needs}

Its scripts can call 323 script bindings. 91 of them are new, which no earlier level of the story calls: 90 are
implemented in Coney and 91 are traced. The full list is on [the coverage
page](../references/bindings/story.md#level95).

## Run it in Coney {#run}

With your own disc ([Playing a level](../guides/building.md#playing-a-level)); `--checkpoint` picks where it starts, 1
to 12:

```text
coney --disc /path/to/disc --play-level level95 --checkpoint 1
```

Its disc test (needs `CONEY_DISC`; [Building](../guides/building.md)):

```text
coney_tests "[disc][hub]"
```

## Notes {#notes}

All twelve checkpoints play headless on the disc with no script error and player 1 walking
(`tests/platform/disc_hub_test.cpp`); nobody has compared them with the original yet.
